title: Exact finite-R n=2 symmetric INF branch theorem
headline_value: kappa^3 = 18pi - 48/pi; unique even analytic finite-interior branch with finite-R correspondence and nondegeneracy.
scope: n=2 real symmetric band-consistent INF branch, M3, all sufficiently large finite R
main_limitation: Local uniqueness is only in the finite nonzero interior chart; u0 is existential and no effective numerical threshold is claimed.

title: Finite-interior scale-exhaustiveness theorem
headline_value: The exact finite-interior germ is analytic in u^2 and exhausts the admitted Puiseux, logarithmic, inverse-logarithmic, mixed, odd, and flat correction class.
scope: Finite nonzero interior n=2 symmetric INF chart only
main_limitation: K -> 0 or infinity, nonunit limiting k3/k2, and phase-denominator singular geometries are outside the admitted class and are not globally classified.

title: Corrected M3 observable and determinant closure
headline_value: m3D-m3N = -(4/kappa^5)u^4 + O(u^6); Chi_up > 0; det Kp_odd ~ (128kappa^2/pi^2)R^(-10/3); det Ko ~ (2048kappa^2/pi^4)R^(-13/3), both positive.
scope: Exact finite-R n=2 symmetric INF branch, M3 only
main_limitation: Depends on the proved finite-interior branch chain; the finite sign threshold R0 is existential and not numerically optimized.

title: Finite-interior Kp odd pivot and exact phase reduction
headline_value: gamma2>b0>0 globally on the finite-interior chart; det Kp_odd>0 iff S_KP<0 iff Phi<0, with exact Jacobi flux and locking-point geometry.
scope: Exact finite-interior real symmetric band-consistent n=2 INF M3 branch points, R>1.
main_limitation: The branch-uniform sign Phi<0, complete KP-DET, KO-DET, non-symmetric roots, and global G1-prime remain open.
